mintAuthority.summary: earnUSD is an upgradeable tokenized ShareManager for Lido/Mellow strategies. Circle controls base USDC issuance; local vaults and registered queues create earnUSD shares. At the October 15 pin, the Proxy Admin Safe is 5-of-8 and the curator Safe is 3-of-6, matching the current deployment table.

review.evidence: Fresh Ethereum pin 26196064, hash 0xe6f654f44af520639428ea34fb84099ac644ba690486e30b6253488d0d4a74fe, timestamp 2026-10-15T06:16:59Z. All 15 supported vault roles, full member sets and zero DEFAULT_ADMIN role-admin edges were re-read and remain unchanged: Lazy Vault Admin holds DEFAULT_ADMIN and SET_SECURITY_PARAMS; Active Vault Admin holds the five allocation/risk-parameter roles; curator holds CALLER, PULL_LIQUIDITY and PUSH_LIQUIDITY; the zero-delay Timelock holds SET_FLAGS, SET_MERKLE_ROOT and SET_QUEUE_STATUS; OracleSubmitter holds SUBMIT_REPORTS and ACCEPT_REPORT. All eight registered queues across USDC, USDT and USDe remain unpaused. The share, vault, Oracle, queues, two subvaults, two verifiers, FeeManager and RiskManager have 17 nonzero EIP-1967 admins, each owned by the same 5-of-8 Proxy Admin Safe. Their implementation/admin/owner identities are now closed at this pin; this does not certify all downstream target logic or alternate-call reach. All four Safe rosters, quorums, terminating empty module pages, zero guards and exact nonzero fallback handlers match the recorded values. The current curator quorum also matches the revised official table. Both verifier roots remain 0x55bf5e57ca0a5e0617a150f6b77434cbb034d8005325c2a733d35bb60082ca46 and 0x0102d740ae91f0c3444a6252ccd84bfd304e8939e2dcb842f58c8a43c01903bb. Every one of the official commit's 8 and 10 Merkle proofs independently recomputes its respective current root; both compact allowlists are empty. Those manifests permit fixed-curator, fixed-target, zero-value calls to underlying earnUSDc/earnUSDe assets and queues, including conditional synchronous redemptions. Complete downstream mutable-target, oracle/debt and fallback execution closure remains unresolved. On-chain authorization and NAV reporting do not establish independent human signers, key custody, independent financial reconciliation or qualifying supervision. At this pin the FeeManager deposit/redeem fees are zero, performanceFeeD6=150000 and protocolFeeD6=2000; these are mutable configuration observations, not all-in execution-cost guarantees.
